properties.title: HydroRIVERS (Africa)
properties.description: Vectorized line network of all global rivers that have a catchment area of at least 10 km² or an average river flow of at least 0.1 m³/sec, or both.

table:columns.name: NEXT_DOWN
table:columns.description: ID of the next downstream reach (0 for reaches that end at the ocean or in an endorheic sink)

table:columns.name: MAIN_RIV
table:columns.description: ID of the most downstream reach of the main river the reach belongs to

table:columns.name: DIST_DN_KM
table:columns.description: Distance from the reach outlet to the river mouth / sink (km)

table:columns.name: DIST_UP_KM
table:columns.description: Distance from the reach outlet to the most upstream point of the river (km)

table:columns.name: CATCH_SKM
table:columns.description: Catchment area of the reach itself (km2)

table:columns.name: UPLAND_SKM
table:columns.description: Total upstream drainage area at the reach outlet (km2)

table:columns.name: ENDORHEIC
table:columns.description: Endorheic flag: 0 = drains to the ocean, 1 = reach flows into an endorheic basin, 2 = reach ends in an endorheic sink (?)

table:columns.name: ORD_CLAS
table:columns.description: River order, classification by average discharge

table:columns.name: ORD_FLOW
table:columns.description: River order, classification by discharge (log10 scale)

table:columns.name: HYBAS_L12
table:columns.description: ID of the HydroBASINS level 12 sub-basin the reach resides in

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
